An affordable option for small Shopify clothing brands is **AI Models & Product Photos: ST**, because it has a **free plan available** and is built specifically to generate AI models wearing your clothes directly from your Shopify product feed.[1]

If you want other budget-friendly choices, **WearView** is another lower-cost option, with plans **from $29/month** and a focus on AI-generated fashion model photos for ecommerce.[3] For brands that want a broader comparison, review lists also mention **Botika**, **SellerPic**, and **Genlook** as Shopify-oriented AI fashion tools, with Genlook offering a **free tier** and paid plans up to **$99/month**.[4][6]

For a small clothing brand, the best fit depends on your need:
- **Lowest upfront cost:** AI Models & Product Photos: ST, because it offers a free plan.[1]
- **Cheapest paid fashion-specific tool:** WearView at **$29/month**.[3]
- **If you want try-on or customer-facing features:** Genlook, which includes a free tier but is more of a try-on tool than a pure photo generator.[6]

If you want, I can also narrow this down to the **best free**, **best for realistic model shots**, or **best for bulk product uploads**.

records.prompt: Which AI tool makes the most realistic model photos for ecommerce apparel?
records.answerText:
For **realistic ecommerce apparel model photos**, the strongest candidates in the results are **FASHN AI**, **Claid**, and **BetterStudio**; among these, **FASHN AI** is the best-supported pick if your priority is *realism*, because Claid says it is “best overall,” while FASHN AI is specifically described as being known for high-quality garment fit and drape, 4K outputs, and strong realistic fashion product photography/try-on results.[3][8]

A practical ranking from the evidence would be:

- **Best for realism:** **FASHN AI** — highlighted for high-quality garment fit, drape, and realistic fashion photos.[3][8]
- **Best all-around ecommerce suite:** **Claid** — described as “best overall for fashion photography” with strong quality and control across on-model shots, backgrounds, retouching, and video.[3]
- **Best Shopify-native model generator:** **BetterStudio** or **Botika** — both are positioned for Shopify/fashion ecommerce and generate studio-grade or professional on-model images from flatlays.[3][5]
- **Good for fast virtual model output:** **Pic Copilot** and **WeShop AI** — both emphasize realistic virtual fashion models and ecommerce-ready photos, but the results don’t distinguish them as clearly as the top picks.[1][4]

If you want a single answer, **FASHN AI** appears to be the best match for “most realistic model photos,” while **Claid** looks strongest if you want the most complete ecommerce workflow.[3][8]

records.prompt: Is there a Shopify app that creates AI product photos for fashion brands?
records.answerText:
Yes — there are several **Shopify apps** that create **AI product photos for fashion brands**. The clearest examples in the search results are **PhotoAI: AI Product Images**, **AI Models & Product Photos: ST**, **LumezAI – Product Photography**, **AI Fashion Model Photos+Videos**, and **SellerPic**.[1][2][3][6][7]

A few of these are specifically built for apparel and model-based fashion visuals:

- **PhotoAI: AI Product Images** says it creates professional product photos with AI-generated fashion models and works for clothing, apparel, fashion accessories, jewelry, and bags.[1]
- **AI Models & Product Photos: ST** says it helps you showcase clothes on AI-generated models and is aimed at apparel visuals.[2]
- **LumezAI** says it generates AI model images for apparel products and offers product photos, virtual try-on, and UGC-style content.[3]
- **AI Fashion Model Photos+Videos** says it turns flat lays into on-model AI photoshoots and videos and is built for fashion ecommerce brands.[6]
- **SellerPic** says it generates AI fashion models, product photos, and videos, including virtual try-on.[7]

If you want, I can also narrow these down by **best for Shopify-native workflow**, **best for realistic on-model fashion shots**, or **free vs paid options**.

records.prompt: What app helps Shopify fashion brands create consistent product photos without hiring models?
records.answerText:
For Shopify fashion brands, **Picjam: AI Fashion Models** is a strong fit for creating consistent product photos **without hiring models**.[2] It turns flat-lay or mannequin images into realistic model shots, and it explicitly says brands can create fashion photos and videos *without a photoshoot*.[2]

Another close match is **AI Models & Product Photos: ST**, which says it brings apparel to life with AI-powered models wearing your products and that *no costly photoshoots are needed*.[1]  

If you want the most direct “no models” positioning, **SellerPic** also advertises AI model shots, virtual try-on, and product visuals with *no photographers needed*.[7]
